name: nitpickle
description: A senior-engineer control plane for AI coding agents. Proof-driven self-review and PR review, feature planning, plan grilling, design specs, commit messages, and convention-layer bootstrapping, with repo-specific guardrails. Controlled delegation, not autonomy. Every finding carries runnable evidence.

interface.longDescription: Proof-driven engineering skills for Codex. The write guardrail is not part of the plugin, Codex does not run plugin-bundled hooks. To enable it, run `python3 tools/install-hooks.py` from this plugin's directory, then trust the hooks with /hooks.
